A stratified 80/20 train-validation split is used, and early stopping with patience of 50 epochs is applied based on validation log loss.

leaf-classification.code_summary: The code loads leaf image and tabular (margin, shape, texture) data from CSV files, performs stratified train/validation split, and engineers extensive tabular features including raw features, per-group statistics (mean, std, skew, kurtosis, entropy), cross-group interactions, and PCA projections standardized with StandardScaler. Images are resized, center-cropped, and normalized using standard ImageNet statistics, then DINOv2 ViT-L/14 extracts 1024-dimensional image features. The model is a multi-modal classifier: tabular features go through a 3-layer MLP projector, image features through a 1-layer MLP projector, followed by bidirectional cross-attention fusion (8-head) and a final classifier head with label smoothing (0.1). Training uses AdamW, cosine annealing LR scheduler, mixed precision (AMP), and early stopping with patience of 50 on validation log loss.
leaf-classification.plan: Looking at the error, the issue is clear: In the forward pass, `final_features = torch.cat([fused, tab_proj, img_proj], dim=1)` creates a tensor of size 2048 (1024 from fused + 512 + 512), but the classifier expects 1536 dimensions. The fix is to remove the redundant concatenation of `tab_proj` and `img_proj` since `fused` already contains cross-attended versions of both. We'll just use `fused` directly (1024 dims) and update the classifier input dimension accordingly.

leaf-classification.code_summary: The solution combines tabular features (margin, shape, texture) with image-derived features from leaf images. Tabular features are augmented with per-sample statistics and cross-correlations, then reduced with PCA and standardized. Image features include contour-based shape metrics (area, perimeter, circularity, solidity, etc.) extracted via OpenCV. A dual-pathway deep learning model is used: a TabularMLP (3 hidden layers: 512->256->128, GELU, BatchNorm, Dropout) processes PCA features, while an EfficientNet-B0 (pretrained, partially frozen) processes resized leaf images. Outputs are fused with fixed weights (0.6 tabular, 0.4 vision). Training uses CrossEntropyLoss with label smoothing, AdamW optimizer, cosine annealing LR schedule, mixed precision (AMP), and early stopping with 10 patience. Validation is done with a single stratified 5-fold split (80/20).

Training uses 5-fold stratified cross-validation with AdamW optimizer, cosine annealing scheduler, label smoothing, early stopping (patience=20), and test-time augmentation (Gaussian noise, 10 repeats) for predictions.

Validation uses a stratified 80/20 split.

leaf-classification.code_summary: The code implements a multimodal leaf classifier combining tabular features (via a Transformer encoder) with image features (via a ResNet-18 backbone). Data preprocessing includes label encoding of species, stratified 5-fold cross-validation splitting, per-fold StandardScaler normalization to prevent leakage, and standard image augmentations (random crop, rotation, flip, color jitter). The model architecture fuses 512-dim image embeddings with 256-dim tabular embeddings, followed by a classifier head with batch norm and dropout. Training uses CrossEntropyLoss with label smoothing, AdamW optimizer with per-component learning rates, mixed precision training via GradScaler/autocast, and early stopping with patience of 10. Validation metric is multiclass log loss.
